prerequisites.title: Free Xero account
prerequisites.detail: Sign up for a free Xero developer account; the demo company is the recommended way to start building.

prerequisites.title: Ten customers using the app
prerequisites.detail: Xero requires ten customers before it will certify the app.

prerequisites.title: Security standard readiness
prerequisites.detail: The assessment covers API risk rating, authentication, encryption, personnel security and audit logging, with 2-step authentication as the minimum.

steps.title: Sign up and open demo company
steps.detail: Create the free Xero account and use the demo company for development.
steps.done_when: You can log in to the Xero developer portal.

steps.title: Register your Xero app
steps.detail: Register the app in the developer portal to get a client ID and client secret.
steps.done_when: You have a client ID and client secret.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the Composio auth config with your client ID and secret via Composio's API, and copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard. Check it is absolute with no wildcard.
steps.done_when: The auth config exists and shows a redirect URI.

steps.title: Add redirect URI in Xero
steps.detail: Paste the Composio redirect URI into your Xero app; up to 50 are allowed.
steps.done_when: A test connection to the demo company completes.

steps.title: Draft security assessment answers
steps.detail: Draft answers against Xero's published security standard for review.
steps.done_when: A draft is ready for your review.

steps.title: Find ten customers and submit
steps.detail: Get ten customers using the app, then complete and submit the assessment.
steps.done_when: The assessment is submitted to Xero.

steps.title: Xero reviews your assessment
steps.detail: Xero's security team reviews the answers and emails the result; it may ask follow-up questions.

steps.title: Create the App Store listing
steps.detail: Create the Xero App Store listing; an agent can draft the text first.
steps.done_when: The app is certified and listed.

traps.title: Annual re-assessment
traps.detail: Partners must pass the security assessment every year, or they lose certification standing.

traps.title: Failing the assessment is slow
traps.detail: A fail means 30 days for a remediation plan and 60 days to implement, then a re-review.

traps.title: Advanced assessment at 1,000 connections
traps.detail: Growth past 1,000 connections triggers a stricter assessment.

traps.title: Managed app is not available
traps.detail: Composio has no managed Xero app, so prototypes also need your own app.

blockers.symptom: Xero asks follow-up questions after you return the assessment
blockers.what_it_means: The security team needs more detail before deciding.
blockers.what_to_do: Answer promptly and wait for the pass or fail email.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft clear answers from your security documentation.

blockers.symptom: Assessment fails and Xero sends a remediation report
blockers.what_to_do: Submit a remediation plan within 30 days and implement changes within 60 days.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft the remediation plan from the report.
